blocks.name: Table top with pedestal leg

blocks.reason: The table top is a worktop-like element separate from the bench carcass, so it is listed as its own block. Its leg is included with it. How it is fixed to the bench or floor is not shown.

uncertainties: It is unclear whether the slatted back (B02) is built into the same assembly as the base unit (B01) or is delivered separately.
